title: plastic shamrocks
text: plastic shamrocks. You get 36 shamrocks... in three versions, all the same position on the hangers... lighter green, darker green and sparkle green.  The tops are a gold color and are strung with gold thread for hanging.  They are brittle plastic.  I am disappointed that a number of them (6) that were not attached to the hangers (minus one star for broken pieces).  I could get out my glue gun, but I didn't buy a craft project.  They came in a clear plastic box that latches.  Even so, there was green glitter every where inside the shipping box.  I purchased them to decorate a stick LED tree that I change the decor seasonally.  These are the perfect size at about 1" or so.  I didn't use them all so I guess I have a few extras.
